dialogue.text: The pot near the back counter is smoking!

dialogue.text: What did you say about the fryer earlier?

dialogue.text: I haven't mentioned the fryer.

dialogue.text: Did I put the rice on the heat before or after I chopped the steak?

dialogue.text: You put the rice on before chopping the steak.
